title: OpenAI client defaults to the hosted API
explanation: The openai package is installed and OPENAI_BASE_URL isn't set, so clients created without base_url call api.openai.com. That is often a hosted fallback for embeddings or completions. Code may still pass base_url explicitly, which this rule can't see.

evidence.detail: openai 1.54.4 installed; not disabled in the image (none of OPENAI_BASE_URL=*)

fix: Set OPENAI_BASE_URL to the in-enclave model server (OpenAI-compatible), or remove the hosted fallback.
